          "size": 20,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "91EBCB",
          "text": "FIELD OBSERVATIONS"
        },
        {
          "id": "11-for-years-the-worst-thing-about-a-basement-spider-was-losing",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 316,
          "top": 207,
          "width": 260,
          "size": 10.2,
          "color": "FFF5D9",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 143,
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one spread its
wings. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white feathers, and a golden halo - every
reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the floor. Later witnesses learned to watch
the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and non-religious people alike have expressed
concerns about what this implies for heaven."
        },
        {
          "id": "12-cinematic-marketing-portrait-original-art-v1",

          "size": 7.5,

          "text": "PREVIEW ARTWORK - NOT A SCREENSHOT"
        }
      ]

        {

          "x": 36,
          "y": 658,
          "size": 22,
          "font": "Condensed",

        },
        {
          "id": "description",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A tight cloud of tiny sewer flies with an unfortunate habit of drifting into everyone’s way. They
wander slowly without hunting, and contact harms plumbers and monsters alike.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 631,
          "width": 540,
          "size": 12,
          "max_height": 62
        },
        {
          "id": "swarm-source-sheet",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/bestiary/sewer-flies/swarm-mockup-v2.png",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 123,
          "width": 280,
          "height": 420,
          "crop": null
        },
        {
          "id": "story-heading",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "AWAITING LANDING CLEARANCE",
          "x": 337,
          "y": 531,
          "size": 15,
          "font": "Condensed",
          "color": "164BD9"
        },
        {
          "id": "draft-lore",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 337,
          "top": 510,
          "width": 239,
          "size": 11.5,
          "max_height": 285
        },
        {
          "id": "approval-note",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>From the field:</b> this account is still taking shape.",
          "x": 337,
          "top": 224,
          "width": 239,
          "size": 10,
          "max_height": 60
        },

          "x": 36,
          "top": 108,
          "width": 540,
          "size": 9.5,
          "max_height": 31
        }
      ],
      "number": 12
    },

          "x": 36,
          "y": 226,
          "size": 20,

          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "text": "THE BLOCKAGE LIVES"
        },
        {
          "id": "07-a-colossal-living-fatberg-of-congealed-grease-wet-wipes-root",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 207,
          "width": 255,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "FFF5D9",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 143,
          "text": "A colossal living fatberg of congealed grease, wet wipes, roots, and things nobody should have
flushed. Wedged into the collection chamber beneath headquarters, it heaves against the pipework and spits the
accumulated consequences back at anyone approaching."
        },
        {
          "id": "08-field-report",
          "type": "text",
          "x": 316,
          "y": 226,
          "size": 20,
          "font": "Display",

          "text": "FIELD REPORT"

        {
          "id": "09-grease-wipes-roots-and-discarded-rubbish-have-packed-togethe",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 316,
          "top": 207,
          "width": 260,
          "size": 10.2,
          "color": "FFF5D9",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 143,
          "text": "Grease, wipes, roots, and discarded rubbish have packed together into a fatberg of appalling
proportions. There's enough ordinary drain trouble in that heap to keep a crew busy for days. Unfortunately, the
heap is moving. Give it room."
        },

          "color": "101B2D",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 110,
          "text": "The pipework is half swallowed by the greasy mass around it. Rust, roots and dripping muck make
it difficult to tell where the plumbing ends and the creature begins. Either way, it is somebody's worst service

        },

          "id": "06-a-separate-pipe-section-lets-the-artists-work-on-shape-surfa",

gloves. Probably a different pair of gloves afterward, too."
        },
        {
          "id": "07-preview-notes-source-art-excerpt-not-a-playable-encounter",
          "type": "text",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 60,
          "size": 8,
          "font": "Bold",
          "color": "164BD9",
          "text": "PREVIEW ARTWORK - AN ENCOUNTER IDEA WE'RE EXPLORING"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "editor-s-closing-credits",
      "number": 16,
      "template": "standard",
      "section": "Equipment preview + credits",
      "elements": [
        {
          "id": "dispenser-preview-label",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FEATURE PREVIEW / SPARE EMPLOYEE DISPENSER",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 738,
          "size": 10,
          "font": "Bold",
          "color": "164BD9"
        },
        {
          "id": "dispenser-headline-1",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "PLEASE COLLECT",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 694,
          "size": 38,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "101B2D"
        },
        {
          "id": "dispenser-headline-2",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "YOUR REPLACEMENT",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 650,
          "size": 38,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "164BD9"
        },
        {
          "id": "dispenser-copy-left",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Most employers would offer an injured plumber a chair. Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply has
ordered a machine.<br/><br/>The Spare Employee Dispenser scans the damage, grabs the employee and crumples the whole
uniform - boots, startled eyes and all - into a compact ball. Then it throws the problem straight at the screen.
There is a splat. The problem slides out of view.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 623,
          "width": 256,
          "size": 11,
          "max_height": 185
        },
        {
          "id": "dispenser-copy-right",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A fresh, fully healed Tony or Sean steps out, looks left, looks right and shrugs. Apparently this
counts as staff retention.<br/><br/>Healthy employees can simply check in and keep their existing shape. Returning
after a mishap uses the dispensing part; there is no need to put the old employee through processing twice.",
          "x": 316,
          "top": 623,
          "width": 260,
          "size": 11,
          "max_height": 185
        },
        {
          "id": "dispenser-status",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Feature preview:</b> coming in a future update to Drain Damage.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 429,
          "width": 540,
          "size": 9,
          "max_height": 32
        },
        {
          "id": "04-rect",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 388,
          "w": 540,
          "h": 4,
          "color": "164BD9"
        },
        {
          "id": "05-about-this-issue",
          "type": "text",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 350,
          "size": 24,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "164BD9",
          "text": "ABOUT THIS ISSUE"
        },
        {
          "id": "06-discharge-quarterly-covers-the-practical-side-of-an-increasi",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 319,
          "width": 540,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "101B2D",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 65,
          "text": "Discharge Quarterly covers the practical side of an increasingly impractical trade. This issue
pairs character and creature artwork with an early look at Drain Damage."
        },
        {
          "id": "07-art-capture-credits",
          "type": "text",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 218,
          "size": 18,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "164BD9",
          "text": "PICTURES & THANKS"
        },
        {
          "id": "08-character-and-creature-illustrations-cover-art-and-sprite-st",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 197,
          "width": 255,
          "size": 9.3,
          "color": "101B2D",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 145,
          "text": "Illustrations and screenshots from Drain Damage.<br/><br/>The screenshots on page 7 show an
earlier version of the game. The Widow pictures imagine an encounter you cannot play yet; they are not screenshots."
        },
        {
          "id": "09-publication-notes",
          "type": "text",
          "x": 316,
          "y": 218,
          "size": 18,
          "font": "Display",
          "color": "164BD9",
          "text": "PUBLICATION NOTES"
        },
        {
          "id": "10-discharge-quarterly-is-a-fictional-journal-for-drain-damage-",
          "type": "para",
          "x": 316,
          "top": 197,
          "width": 260,
          "size": 9.3,
          "color": "101B2D",
          "leading": null,
          "max_height": 145,
          "text": "Discharge Quarterly is a fictional journal for Drain Damage. The Plumbing, Heating &amp; Creature
Containment Association (PHCC) is fictional; no real PHCC affiliation or endorsement is implied. Mainframe Plumbing
&amp; Supply is the game's company name.<br/><br/>Inspired by 1990s game magazines; not affiliated with Nintendo
Power or GamePro."
        },
        {
          "id": "11-edition-12-october-15-2026",

          "x": 36,
          "y": 45,
          "size": 8,
          "font": "Italic",
          "color": "101B2D",
          "text": "Edition 16 / October 16, 2026"
        }
      ]

          "w": 270,
          "h": 24,
          "color": "1744B9"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-024",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TONY",
          "x": 32,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-025",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE EXPERIENCED HAND",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony comes from four generations of plumbers and has spent decades installing, building, and
keeping essential systems running. He takes the work seriously and makes time to teach Sean properly. A difficult
job won't put him off. A large spider might slow him down a little.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-027",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TRADE ROOTS",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Plumbing runs in Tony's family. He brings that accumulated knowledge to the job, along with the
patience to explain what he's doing. Sean has a great deal to learn, and Tony intends to give him the chance.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-029",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-030",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 33,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-031",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony's pressure gun fires quickly, so keep your aim steady and give yourself room when the
creatures close in.",
          "x": 33,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 35,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-032",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 374,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 201,
          "color": "FFE4AD"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-033",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/portraits/sean-expressions-v4.png",
          "x": 347,
          "y": 369,
          "width": 212,
          "height": 212,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            397,
            396
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-034",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 354,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 24,
          "color": "E62A32"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-035",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "SEAN",
          "x": 326,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-036",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE APPRENTICE",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-037",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean wandered in looking for work and somehow ended up on Tony's crew. He's willing to help,
although it's worth checking what he's holding before asking him to hand you a tool. Tony is showing him the ropes.
There are quite a few ropes.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-038",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FIRST DAY",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-039",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean arrived without much knowledge of plumbing. Tony took him on anyway. For now, enthusiasm is
doing a lot of the work, and a patient teacher is keeping the rest moving.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-040",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-041",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 327,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-042",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean's heavy plunger launcher hits hard. Make each shot count, and leave yourself room while he
reloads.",
          "x": 327,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",

        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",
          "x": 402,
          "y": 647,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,
          "top": 632,

        {

          "crop": [
            0,

            443,
            565
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Most employers would offer an injured plumber a chair. Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply has
ordered a machine.<br/><br/>The Spare Employee Dispenser scans the damage, grabs the employee and crumples the whole
uniform - boots, startled eyes and all - into a compact ball. Then it throws the problem straight at the screen.
There is a splat. The problem slides out of view.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A fresh, fully healed Tony or Sean steps out, looks left, looks right and shrugs. Apparently this
counts as staff retention.<br/><br/>Healthy employees can simply check in and keep their existing shape. Returning
after a mishap uses the dispensing part; there is no need to put the old employee through processing twice.",
          "x": 238,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 185,
          "size": 11,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its
bowl, and short pipe legs. It patrols until a plumber gets too close, then closes the distance with a hop. The
service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,

following you, the appointment has moved beyond routine maintenance.",

        {

          "text": "02",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 370,
          "size": 32,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-022",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 246,
          "y": 332,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 334,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "DF1684",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one spread its
wings. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white feathers, and a golden halo - every
reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the floor. Later witnesses learned to watch
the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and non-religious people alike have expressed
concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-025",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 72,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 70,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Tony:</b> \"I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.\"",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 130,
          "width": 435,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 44,
          "leading": 16.8,

          "x": 340,

          "width": 246,

          "crop": null
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-012",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "03 / A BLOCKAGE WITH AMBITION",
          "x": 26,
          "y": 642,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "008C70",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-013",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A colossal living fatberg of congealed grease, wet wipes, roots, and things nobody should have
flushed. Wedged into the collection chamber beneath headquarters, it heaves against the pipework and spits the
accumulated consequences back at anyone approaching.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 629,
          "width": 291,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 111,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Grease, wipes, roots, and discarded rubbish have packed together into a fatberg of appalling
proportions. There's enough ordinary drain trouble in that heap to keep a crew busy for days. Unfortunately, the
heap is moving. Give it room.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 521,
          "width": 291,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Preview artwork - an encounter idea we are exploring.",
          "x": 340,
          "top": 401,
          "width": 246,
          "size": 9.5,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "max_height": 29,
          "leading": 10.64,

        {

          "size": 35,

          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-019",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "04 / NO FLIGHT PLAN. PLENTY OF BUZZ.",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 285,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-020",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/bestiary/sewer-flies/swarm-mockup-v2.png",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 113,
          "width": 154,
          "height": 154,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            256,
            256
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 267,
          "width": 369,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 157,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-022",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A tight cloud of flies. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for getting in its way.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 111,
          "width": 154,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 42,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-023",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This account is still taking shape. Preview artwork - not a screenshot.",
          "x": 206,

        {

          "h": 24,
          "color": "1744B9"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "ON YOUR TOES",
          "x": 416,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 18,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The first sign of trouble is usually the fixture moving toward you. The second is the realization
that you have been standing much too close to it.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 626,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 125,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 506,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "max_height": 71,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-016",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "Shown in an earlier version of the game.",
          "x": 26,
          "y": 441,
          "size": 10,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "font": "Italic"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 27,
          "y": 384,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 25,
          "y": 386,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",
          "x": 410,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 176,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },

        {
          "id": "crew-024",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TONY",
          "x": 32,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-025",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE EXPERIENCED HAND",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony comes from four generations of plumbers and has spent decades installing, building, and
keeping essential systems running. He takes the work seriously and makes time to teach Sean properly. A difficult
job won't put him off. A large spider might slow him down a little.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-027",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TRADE ROOTS",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Plumbing runs in Tony's family. He brings that accumulated knowledge to the job, along with the
patience to explain what he's doing. Sean has a great deal to learn, and Tony intends to give him the chance.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-029",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-030",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 33,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-031",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony's pressure gun fires quickly, so keep your aim steady and give yourself room when the
creatures close in.",
          "x": 33,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 35,

        },
        {
          "id": "crew-035",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "SEAN",
          "x": 326,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-036",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE APPRENTICE",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-037",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean wandered in looking for work and somehow ended up on Tony's crew. He's willing to help,
although it's worth checking what he's holding before asking him to hand you a tool. Tony is showing him the ropes.
There are quite a few ropes.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-038",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FIRST DAY",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-039",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean arrived without much knowledge of plumbing. Tony took him on anyway. For now, enthusiasm is
doing a lot of the work, and a patient teacher is keeping the rest moving.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-012",

          "x": 198,

          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",
          "x": 402,
          "y": 647,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 186,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002

            0,

            565
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Most employers would offer an injured plumber a chair. Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply has
ordered a machine.<br/><br/>The Spare Employee Dispenser scans the damage, grabs the employee and crumples the whole
uniform - boots, startled eyes and all - into a compact ball. Then it throws the problem straight at the screen. The
ball hits with a splat and slides out of view.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A fresh, fully healed Tony or Sean steps out, looks left, looks right and shrugs. Apparently this
counts as staff retention.<br/><br/>Healthy employees can simply check in and keep their existing shape. Returning
after a mishap uses the dispensing part; there is no need to put the old employee through processing twice.",
          "x": 238,
          "top": 273,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-014",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FLUSHFIEND",
          "x": 294,
          "y": 628,
          "size": 31,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its
bowl, and short pipe legs. It patrols until a plumber gets too close, then closes the distance with a hop. The
service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 609,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 104,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-016",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Service tip:</b> Look for pipe legs, red eyes and teeth around the bowl. If it starts
following you, the appointment has moved beyond routine maintenance.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 521,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 62,
          "leading": 12.88

        {

          "type": "rect",

          "h": 28,
          "color": "E62A32"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALO DOESN'T MAKE THE FANGS ANY LESS WORRYING.",

        {

          "x": 244,
          "y": 370,
          "size": 32,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-022",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 246,
          "y": 332,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 334,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "DF1684",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one spread its
wings. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white feathers, and a golden halo - every
reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the floor. Later witnesses learned to watch
the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and non-religious people alike have expressed
concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-025",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 72,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 70,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Tony:</b> \"I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.\"",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 130,
          "width": 435,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 44,
          "leading": 16.8,

        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-012",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "03 / A BLOCKAGE WITH AMBITION",
          "x": 26,
          "y": 642,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "008C70",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-013",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A colossal living fatberg of congealed grease, wet wipes, roots, and things nobody should have
flushed. Wedged into the collection chamber beneath headquarters, it heaves against the pipework and spits the
accumulated consequences back at anyone approaching.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 629,
          "width": 291,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 111,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Grease, wipes, roots, and discarded rubbish have packed together into a fatberg of appalling
proportions. There's enough ordinary drain trouble in that heap to keep a crew busy for days. Unfortunately, the
heap is moving. Give it room.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 521,
          "width": 291,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Preview artwork - an encounter idea we are exploring.",
          "x": 340,
          "top": 401,
          "width": 246,
          "size": 9.5,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "max_height": 29,
          "leading": 10.64,

        },

          "text": "SEPTIC AIR FORCE",
          "x": 37,
          "y": 310,

        {

          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-019",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "04 / STILL WAITING FOR LANDING CLEARANCE",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 285,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-020",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/bestiary/sewer-flies/swarm-mockup-v2.png",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 113,
          "width": 154,
          "height": 154,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            256,
            256
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 267,
          "width": 369,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 157,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-022",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This tight cloud of flies hurts plumbers and monsters alike when they cross its path.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 111,
          "width": 154,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 42,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-023",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This account is still taking shape. Preview artwork - not a screenshot.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 89,
          "width": 369,
          "size": 9.5,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "max_height": 25,

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "ON YOUR TOES",
          "x": 416,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 18,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A moving fixture is your cue to back away. By the time it reaches your boots, you will want more
room than you left yourself.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 626,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 125,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 506,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "max_height": 71,
          "leading": 12.32

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-016",

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 27,
          "y": 384,
          "size": 29,

          "font": "Display",

        {

          "type": "text",

          "size": 29,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",
          "x": 410,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 176,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001

gameplay is unfinished.",

        {
          "id": "crew-024",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TONY",
          "x": 32,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-025",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE EXPERIENCED HAND",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony comes from four generations of plumbers and has spent decades installing, building, and
keeping essential systems running. He takes the work seriously and makes time to teach Sean properly. A difficult
job won't put him off. A large spider might slow him down a little.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-027",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TRADE ROOTS",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Plumbing runs in Tony's family. He brings that accumulated knowledge to the job, along with the
patience to explain what he's doing. Sean has a great deal to learn, and Tony intends to give him the chance.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-029",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-030",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 33,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-031",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony's pressure gun fires quickly, so keep your aim steady and give yourself room when the
creatures close in.",
          "x": 33,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 35,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002

          "h": 201,
          "color": "FFE4AD"

          "h": 24,
          "color": "E62A32"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-035",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "SEAN",
          "x": 326,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-036",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE APPRENTICE",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-037",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean wandered in looking for work and somehow ended up on Tony's crew. He's willing to help,
although it's worth checking what he's holding before asking him to hand you a tool. Tony is showing him the ropes.
There are quite a few ropes.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-038",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FIRST DAY",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-039",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean arrived without much knowledge of plumbing. Tony took him on anyway. For now, enthusiasm is
doing a lot of the work, and a patient teacher is keeping the rest moving.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",

          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",

          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply is pleased to announce a new approach to employee welfare. The
Spare Employee Dispenser promises to have Tony and Sean fit for duty with a minimum of paperwork.<br/><br/>The
brochure calls the procedure \"staff renewal.\" It devotes considerably more space to the reduction in sick leave
than to what happens during an appointment.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Employees are assured that their position will remain filled throughout the process. Whether this
is the reassurance they were looking for appears to be outside the scope of the brochure.<br/><br/>BJ considers the
matter settled. The next service call is already on the schedule.",

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its

service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",

          "size": 26,

          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one sprouted
wings and apparently started breeding. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white
feathers, and a golden halo - every reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the
floor. Later witnesses learned to watch the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and
non-religious people alike have expressed concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",

          "top": 267,

          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",

          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",

          "text": "Tony comes from four generations of plumbers and has spent decades installing, building, and

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-012",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "BILLY-JOE",
          "x": 198,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 30,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",
          "x": 402,
          "y": 647,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 186,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-016",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 198,
          "y": 441,
          "w": 388,
          "h": 31,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "BJ IS TAKING AN UNWELCOME INTEREST IN YOUR WORK.",
          "x": 206,
          "y": 453,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Bold"
        },

        {

          "y": 294,
          "size": 31,

          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-026",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "marketing/spare-employee-dispenser/tony-stocked-v1.png",
          "x": 443,
          "y": 186,
          "width": 137,
          "height": 175,
          "crop": null
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply would like you to know that arrangements have been made. The
Spare Employee Dispenser stands ready between service calls, its glass front offering a reassuring view of the
company\u2019s preparations. There is rust around the hinges and something familiar about the occupants. The
accompanying leaflet describes them as reserve personnel. It asks employees to respect their rest and directs all
further questions to the same leaflet.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The leaflet is particularly clear on continuity of service. Your assignments will remain on the
schedule, your tools will still be required, and your name will stay on the rota. Several paragraphs explain how
much the company values an experienced employee. The section headed \u201cWhat this means for you\u201d refers back
to those paragraphs. We would have preferred a little more detail, but the cabinet does appear to be well stocked.",
          "x": 238,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 185,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-029",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/world/spare-employee-dispenser/sean-v2.png",
          "x": 464,
          "y": 101,
          "width": 90,
          "height": 85,
          "crop": [
            0,
            840,
            418,
            414
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-030",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The company asks that reserve personnel not be disturbed.",
          "x": 430,
          "size": 10,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Italic",
          "top": 95,
          "width": 150,
          "leading": 12,
          "max_height": 38
        }
      ]

        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its
bowl, and short pipe legs. It patrols until a plumber gets too close, then closes the distance with a hop. The
service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 609,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 104,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-016",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Service tip:</b> Look for pipe legs, red eyes and teeth around the bowl. If it starts
following you, the appointment has moved beyond routine maintenance.",

          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-022",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 246,
          "y": 332,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 334,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "DF1684",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one sprouted
wings and apparently started breeding. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white
feathers, and a golden halo - every reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the
floor. Later witnesses learned to watch the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and
non-religious people alike have expressed concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-025",
          "type": "rect",

          "y": 72,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 70,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Tony:</b> \"I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.\"",

          "top": 130,
          "width": 435,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "111421",

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 267,

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-009",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "LEAVE YOURSELF ROOM BEFORE THE FLUSHFIEND STARTS HOPPING.",

        {

          "type": "rect",

          "y": 641,
          "w": 178,
          "h": 24,
          "color": "1744B9"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "ON YOUR TOES",
          "x": 416,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 18,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A moving fixture is your cue to back away. By the time it reaches your boots, you will want more
room than you left yourself.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 626,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 125,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 506,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "max_height": 71,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 27,
          "y": 384,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 25,
          "y": 386,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",
          "x": 410,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 176,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-022",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 78,

          "top": 69,

        {
          "id": "crew-039",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean arrived without much knowledge of plumbing. Tony took him on anyway. For now, enthusiasm is
doing a lot of the work, and a patient teacher is keeping the rest moving.",

          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-012",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "BILLY-JOE",
          "x": 198,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 30,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",
          "x": 402,
          "y": 647,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 186,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-016",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 198,
          "y": 441,
          "w": 388,
          "h": 31,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "BJ IS TAKING AN UNWELCOME INTEREST IN YOUR WORK.",
          "x": 206,
          "y": 453,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Bold"
        },

        {

          "y": 294,

          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-026",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "marketing/spare-employee-dispenser/tony-stocked-v1.png",
          "x": 443,
          "y": 186,
          "width": 137,
          "height": 175,
          "crop": null
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply would like you to know that arrangements have been made. The
Spare Employee Dispenser stands ready between service calls, its glass front offering a reassuring view of the
company\u2019s preparations. There is rust around the hinges and something familiar about the occupants. The
accompanying leaflet describes them as reserve personnel. It asks employees to respect their rest and directs all
further questions to the same leaflet.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The leaflet is particularly clear on continuity of service. Your assignments will remain on the
schedule, your tools will still be required, and your name will stay on the rota. Several paragraphs explain how
much the company values an experienced employee. The section headed \u201cWhat this means for you\u201d refers back
to those paragraphs. We would have preferred a little more detail, but the cabinet does appear to be well stocked.",
          "x": 238,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 185,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-029",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/world/spare-employee-dispenser/sean-v2.png",
          "x": 464,
          "y": 101,
          "width": 90,
          "height": 85,
          "crop": [
            0,
            840,
            418,
            414
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-030",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The company asks that reserve personnel not be disturbed.",
          "x": 430,
          "size": 10,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Italic",
          "top": 95,
          "width": 150,
          "leading": 12,
          "max_height": 38
        }
      ]

        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its
bowl, and short pipe legs. It patrols until a plumber gets too close, then closes the distance with a hop. The
service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 609,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 104,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-016",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Service tip:</b> Look for pipe legs, red eyes and teeth around the bowl. If it starts
following you, the appointment has moved beyond routine maintenance.",

          "top": 521,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-022",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 246,
          "y": 332,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 334,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "DF1684",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one sprouted
wings and apparently started breeding. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white
feathers, and a golden halo - every reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the
floor. Later witnesses learned to watch the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and
non-religious people alike have expressed concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-025",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 72,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 70,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Tony:</b> \"I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.\"",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 130,
          "width": 435,
          "size": 15,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-019",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "04 / STILL WAITING FOR LANDING CLEARANCE",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 285,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-020",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/bestiary/sewer-flies/swarm-mockup-v2.png",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 113,
          "width": 154,
          "height": 154,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            256,
            256
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 267,
          "width": 369,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 157,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-022",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This tight cloud of flies hurts plumbers and monsters alike when they cross its path.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 111,
          "width": 154,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 42,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "clogfather-tony-reaction",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "marketing/character-reactions/tony-clogfather-horror-v1.png",
          "x": 143,
          "y": 366,
          "width": 172,
          "height": 172,
          "crop": null
        }
      ]
    },

        {
          "id": "on-the-job-009",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "LEAVE YOURSELF ROOM BEFORE THE FLUSHFIEND STARTS HOPPING.",
          "x": 26,

        {

        {

          "type": "rect",

          "y": 641,
