          "h": 24,
          "color": "1744B9"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "ON YOUR TOES",
          "x": 416,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 18,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A moving fixture is your cue to back away. By the time it reaches your boots, you will want more
room than you left yourself.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 626,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 125,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 506,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "max_height": 71,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 27,
          "y": 384,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 25,
          "y": 386,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",
          "x": 410,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 176,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-022",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 78,

          "h": 153,
          "color": "00BADA"

          "y": 354,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 24,
          "color": "1744B9"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-024",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TONY",
          "x": 32,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-025",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE EXPERIENCED HAND",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony comes from four generations of plumbers and has spent decades installing, building, and
keeping essential systems running. He takes the work seriously and makes time to teach Sean properly. A difficult
job won't put him off. A large spider might slow him down a little.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-027",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TRADE ROOTS",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Plumbing runs in Tony's family. He brings that accumulated knowledge to the job, along with the
patience to explain what he's doing. Sean has a great deal to learn, and Tony intends to give him the chance.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-029",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-030",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 33,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-031",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony's pressure gun fires quickly, so keep your aim steady and give yourself room when the
creatures close in.",
          "x": 33,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 35,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-032",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 374,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 201,
          "color": "FFE4AD"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-033",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "marketing/hero-portraits/sean-hyperreal-v1.png",
          "x": 347,
          "y": 369,
          "width": 212,
          "height": 212,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            1122,
            1122
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-034",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 354,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 24,
          "color": "E62A32"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-035",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "SEAN",
          "x": 326,
          "y": 351,
          "size": 25,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-036",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE APPRENTICE",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 330,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-037",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean wandered in looking for work and somehow ended up on Tony's crew. He's willing to help,
although it's worth checking what he's holding before asking him to hand you a tool. Tony is showing him the ropes.
There are quite a few ropes.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 323,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 100,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-038",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "FIRST DAY",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 210,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-039",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean arrived without much knowledge of plumbing. Tony took him on anyway. For now, enthusiasm is
doing a lot of the work, and a patient teacher is keeping the rest moving.",
          "x": 318,
          "top": 203,
          "width": 270,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 85,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-040",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 318,
          "y": 47,
          "w": 270,
          "h": 64,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-041",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "TOOL TALK",
          "x": 327,
          "y": 93,
          "size": 13,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "crew-042",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Sean's heavy plunger launcher hits hard. Make each shot count, and leave yourself room while he
reloads.",
          "x": 327,
          "top": 86,
          "width": 252,
          "size": 10.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 35,
          "leading": 11.760000000000002

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-012",

          "text": "BILLY-JOE",
          "x": 198,
          "y": 645,
          "size": 30,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-013",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "CALL HIM BJ.",
          "x": 402,
          "y": 647,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Billy-Joe runs Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply from a beige server rack. Every plumbing company
and distribution warehouse in the country answers to him, so asking for a different manager won't get you very far.
Tony and Sean get their assignments from his green screen. BJ has plenty of work for them and very little interest
in hearing why it might be unpleasant.",
          "x": 198,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 184,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "BJ speaks calmly, keeps the jobs coming, and expects his employees to get on with them. If you're
hoping the smiling face means he's concerned about your welfare, you may want to ask a more specific question.",
          "x": 400,
          "top": 632,
          "width": 186,
          "size": 11.4,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 159,
          "leading": 12.768000000000002

        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "BJ IS TAKING AN UNWELCOME INTEREST IN YOUR WORK.",
          "x": 206,
          "y": 453,

          "color": "111421",

          "y": 294,
          "size": 31,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "font": "Display",

          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-026",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "marketing/spare-employee-dispenser/tony-stocked-v1.png",
          "x": 443,
          "y": 186,
          "width": 137,
          "height": 175,
          "crop": null
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-027",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Mainframe Plumbing &amp; Supply would like you to know that arrangements have been made. The
Spare Employee Dispenser stands ready between service calls, its glass front offering a reassuring view of the
company\u2019s preparations. There is rust around the hinges and something familiar about the occupants. The
accompanying leaflet describes them as reserve personnel. It asks employees to respect their rest and directs all
further questions to the same leaflet.",
          "x": 24,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 196,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-028",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The leaflet is particularly clear on continuity of service. Your assignments will remain on the
schedule, your tools will still be required, and your name will stay on the rota. Several paragraphs explain how
much the company values an experienced employee. The section headed \u201cWhat this means for you\u201d refers back
to those paragraphs. We would have preferred a little more detail, but the cabinet does appear to be well stocked.",
          "x": 238,
          "top": 273,
          "width": 185,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 170,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "management-maintenance-029",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/world/spare-employee-dispenser/sean-v2.png",
          "x": 464,

          "type": "para",

          "size": 10,
          "color": "E62A32",
          "font": "Italic",
          "top": 95,
          "width": 150,
          "leading": 12,

          "text": "This bad-tempered fixture has burning red eyes under a lid-like brow, ceramic teeth around its
bowl, and short pipe legs. It patrols until a plumber gets too close, then closes the distance with a hop. The
service appointment is unlikely to go as planned.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 609,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 104,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-016",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Service tip:</b> Look for pipe legs, red eyes and teeth around the bowl. If it starts
following you, the appointment has moved beyond routine maintenance.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 521,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 62,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-017",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 414,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 28,
          "color": "E62A32"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALO DOESN'T MAKE THE FANGS ANY LESS WORRYING.",
          "x": 34,
          "y": 421,
          "size": 16,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-019",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 160,
          "w": 206,

        {

          "crop": [
            70,
            0,
            884,
            1028
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-021",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "02",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 370,
          "size": 32,
          "color": "1744B9",
          "font": "Display"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-022",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 246,
          "y": 332,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-023",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "THE HALLOWED WIDOW",
          "x": 244,
          "y": 334,
          "size": 26,
          "color": "DF1684",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-024",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "For years, the worst thing about a basement spider was losing sight of it. Then one sprouted
wings and apparently started breeding. The Hallowed Widow is a huge, hairy nightmare with ivory fangs, white
feathers, and a golden halo - every reassuring detail attached to the wrong animal. Early witnesses watched the
floor. Later witnesses learned to watch the ceiling, too. Nobody knows where the wings came from. Religious and
non-religious people alike have expressed concerns about what this implies for heaven.",
          "x": 244,
          "top": 318,
          "width": 342,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 161,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-025",
          "type": "rect",
          "x": 24,
          "y": 72,
          "w": 564,
          "h": 70,
          "color": "FFF000"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-one-026",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>Tony:</b> \"I was hoping spiders went somewhere else when they died.\"",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 130,
          "width": 435,
          "size": 15,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 44,
          "leading": 16.8,
          "font": "Bold"
        },
        {

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-012",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "03 / A BLOCKAGE WITH AMBITION",
          "x": 26,
          "y": 642,

          "color": "008C70",
          "font": "Condensed"
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-013",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A colossal living fatberg of congealed grease, wet wipes, roots, and things nobody should have
flushed. Wedged into the collection chamber beneath headquarters, it heaves against the pipework and spits the
accumulated consequences back at anyone approaching.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 629,
          "width": 291,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 111,

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-019",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "04 / STILL WAITING FOR LANDING CLEARANCE",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 285,
          "size": 14,
          "color": "E62A32",

        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-020",
          "type": "image",
          "path": "assets/bestiary/sewer-flies/swarm-mockup-v2.png",
          "x": 36,
          "y": 113,
          "width": 154,
          "height": 154,
          "crop": [
            0,
            0,
            256,
            256
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The Septic Air Force earned its name when a maintenance crew found a swarm circling a blocked
vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the
sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for
something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody
has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.",
          "x": 206,
          "top": 267,
          "width": 369,
          "size": 11.5,
          "color": "111421",
          "max_height": 157,
          "leading": 12.88
        },
        {
          "id": "creature-feature-two-022",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "This tight cloud of flies hurts plumbers and monsters alike when they cross its path.",
          "x": 36,
          "top": 111,
          "width": 154,

        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-014",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "A moving fixture is your cue to back away. By the time it reaches your boots, you will want more
room than you left yourself.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 626,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 125,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-015",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "<b>FIELD TIP:</b> Keep some clear floor behind you. A wall is a poor escape route.",
          "x": 408,
          "top": 506,
          "width": 178,
          "size": 11,
          "color": "FFF000",
          "max_height": 71,
          "leading": 12.32
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-017",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 27,
          "y": 384,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "111421",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-018",
          "type": "text",
          "text": "DON'T LET IT CLOSE THE GAP.",
          "x": 25,
          "y": 386,
          "size": 29,
          "color": "00BADA",
          "font": "Display",
          "angle": 0,
          "outline": "FFFFFF",
          "stroke_width": 0.35
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-019",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "The toilet follows Sean and hurts him when it catches him. After a hit, you have a brief chance
to get clear before it can hurt you again. Use it.",
          "x": 26,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-020",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Tony can keep the pressure on with quick shots. Sean needs a little more breathing room between
heavy plungers. Either way, standing still gives the teeth time to catch up.",
          "x": 218,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 174,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001
        },
        {
          "id": "on-the-job-021",
          "type": "para",
          "text": "Watch the floor ahead as well as the creature behind. You need room for the next shot, the next
landing and whatever the building has decided to do next.",
          "x": 410,
          "top": 367,
          "width": 176,
          "size": 12,
          "color": "FFFFFF",
          "max_height": 120,
          "leading": 13.440000000000001

      "prompt": "Use case: stylized-concept. Original SNES pixel-art DEMOLITION HAMMER weapon atlas for Sean in
side-scrolling plumbing action game. Oversized heavy rectangular STEEL sledgehammer head with worn bright edges,
sturdy dark shaft and ORANGE rubber grip, chunky dark navy outlines, clear pixel clusters. Exactly 3 columns x 3
rows of equal cells, transparent square canvas. No person or hands. Row1: diagonal inventory icon full hammer; held
ready hammer diagonal up-right; windup hammer raised overhead to left. Row2: strike hammer slamming down-right head
leading; follow-through hammer low diagonal right; isolated broad pale orange swing arc. Row3: small orange-white
ground contact star with gray debris; large low radial impact shockwave with stone chips; settling gray dust and
chips. All full tool sprites same scale and same lower grip pivot position within cell. Keep head/shaft/grip
identical in all poses. Big weighty overhead-slam impression. All 9 sprites entirely inside separate cells with wide
margins; no overlapping edges, no clipping. Transparent zero-alpha backdrop, opaque sprite interiors, no atmospheric
haze, no ground plane, no text labels grids or UI."
    }

plumbing tools, clean cream highly legible typography. Reference image is style and Pressure Gun identity reference
only. Not a gameplay screenshot or animation atlas; an inventory concept overview. Title \"DRAIN DAMAGE — WEAPON
ROSTER\". Subtitle \"6 catalog weapons + 7 concepts | Mockup, not runtime sprites\". Exactly THREE COLUMNS and FIVE
ROWS of equally sized organized cards below header. Each card has one large isolated side-view pixel art tool above
its exact name and smaller category/status labels. First13cards contain weapons, final2cards contain concise
legends. Generous spacing, no cropped labels, readable text. No characters, hands, real weapon manufacturing
instructions or branding.\nCards in strict row-major order:\n1 \"Pipe Wrench\" / \"MELEE\" / \"CATALOG · TONY\":
compact teal-handled steel pipe wrench.\n2 \"Drain Snake\" / \"MELEE · EXTENDED REACH\" / \"CATALOG · TONY\": coiled
flexible steel cable with small auger and hand grip.\n3 \"Pressure Gun\" / \"SHORT-RANGE\" / \"PLAYABLE · TONY\":
brass barrel teal pistol grip cream pressure gauge, little cyan water bolt, match reference.\n4 \"Demolition
Hammer\" / \"MELEE\" / \"CATALOG · SEAN\": oversized steel sledgehammer orange grip.\n5 \"Heavy Plunger Launcher\" /
\"SHORT-RANGE · HALF-SCREEN\" / \"PLAYABLE · SEAN\": bulky orange and silver launcher, red plunger cup on barrel
tip.\n6 \"Pipe-Bomb Launcher\" / \"LONG-RANGE · LOBBED\" / \"CATALOG · SEAN\": exaggerated fictional chunky
industrial teal/orange launcher, capped cartoon canister nearby; no construction details.\n7 \"Kinetic Air Ram\" /
\"SHORT-RANGE\" / \"IDEA\": cylindrical metal hand pump with pistol grip black rubber nozzle and subtle white air
puff.\n8 \"Toilet Auger\" / \"MELEE · EXTENDED REACH\" / \"IDEA\": bent tubular handle with crank and long flexible
whipping cable, visually different from coiled drain snake.\n9 \"Plunger Water Wave\" / \"LONG-RANGE · SCREEN-WIDE\"
/ \"IDEA · SPECIAL\": upright wooden plunger planted in small floor patch unleashing curling cyan wave, no hero.\n10
\"Soldering Torch\" / \"SHORT-RANGE\" / \"IDEA\": compact B-tank connected by hose to brass torch with short orange
flame; stylized tool, no real branding.\n11 \"Three-Foot Pipe Wrench\" / \"MELEE\" / \"IDEA\": huge long red-handled
pipe wrench, clearly longer heavier than card1.\n12 \"Drain-Machine Cable\" / \"LONG-RANGE · SCREEN-WIDE\" / \"IDEA
· SPECIAL\": squat wheeled red industrial drain machine and forward shooting cable, no branding.\n13 \"Pressure
Fan\" / \"SHORT-RANGE · SPREAD\" / \"IDEA · TONY PICKUP\": modified brass/teal pressure gun with flared three-jet
nozzle and three separated blue bolts.\n14 Text-only legend: \"STATUS\" then \"PLAYABLE: current starters\" then
\"CATALOG: designed, not all playable\" then \"IDEA: proposed, not approved\".\n15 Text-only legend: \"RANGE NOTES\"
then \"Idea ranges are provisional.\" then \"Augers use melee reach.\" then \"Specials are not ordinary weapons.\"
then \"Overlapping concepts remain separate.\"\nKeep exact names correctly spelled, all13weapons visible, no
invented extra weapons. Each tool recognizable at small size with dark outlines, pixel highlights, consistent visual
scale except intentional giant wrench. No photorealism.",
